αἰπὺν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; masc. acc. sg.
αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἶψ: αἶψα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (αἶψ’ = αἶψα)
αὐδήεσσα: αὐδήεις — endowed with speech or voice (from αὐδή); anciently explained as ’speaking with a human voice’, exact force debated; fem. nom. sg.
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’she herself’, ’you yourself’ · also fem. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὴ δὲ χθαμαλὴ κεῖται ’and the island itself lies low’) · also intensive, 1st person: ’I myself’ (οἶδα καὶ αὐτή ’I know it myself’)
αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a raft, fem.), governed by a preposition: ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ’upon it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, possessive with a noun: νόος ... αὐτῆς ’her mind’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, governed by a preposition, of a monster: ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ’away from her’
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’) · also used alone as a plain personal pronoun, ’him’, not reinforcing anything (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ μηχανόωνται ’are plotting against him’) · also with a noun, ’own, very’, in the dat. of accompaniment: αὐτῷ φάρει ’with the cloak itself, cloak and all’ · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοὶ αὐτῷ) · also plain pronoun of a thing, ’it’, after a preposition (ἀμφ’ αὐτῷ ’around it’)
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βαλὼν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck, striking’
βοὸς: βοῦς — ox, cow, heifer; gen. sg.
βοῦς: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; acc. pl. · also masc./fem. nom. sg. (same spelling as the acc. pl.): ’the ox, the heifer’ (ἦλθε ... βοῦς ’the heifer came’)
βοῶν: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; gen. pl.
βροτοῖσιν: βροτός — mortal, mortal man; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
βόας: βοῦς — ox, cow, head of cattle; acc. pl. βόας (= Attic βοῦς)
βόες: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; masc./fem. nom. pl.
γίγνετο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγίγνετο): ’was becoming, turned into’
γαιάων: γαῖα — land, earth; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαφυρῆς: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed; fem. gen. sg.
δαίνυντ: δαίνυμι — feast, give a feast; mid. feast, partake; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, elided (δαίνυντ’ = δαίνυντο)
δεινήν: δεινός — dread, terrible; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Χάρυβδιν
δεινὴ: δεινός — dread, terrible, awesome; fem. nom. sg.
δεκάτῃ: δέκατος — tenth; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with νυκτί: ’on the tenth (night)’ · also fem. dat. sg. with ἡμέρῃ understood: ’on the tenth (day)’
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’)
δοῦρα: δόρυ — tree-trunk, beam, timber; also spear-shaft, spear; neut. nom./acc. pl.
δυνάμεσθα: δύναμαι — be able, can; epic pres. opt. 1 pl. (= Attic δυναίμεθα): with κεν ’we could’
δόρπον: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. acc. sg.
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’)
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἰσιδέειν: εἰσοράω — look at, behold; aor. inf. (stem εἰσιδ-), epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσιδεῖν): ’to look upon’
εἶχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 1 sg. (the form also serves 3 pl.): ’I had’
εὐρέι: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐρεῖ)
εὑρέμεναι: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic εὑρεῖν)
ζείδωρον: ζείδωρος — grain-giving (of ploughland); fem. acc. sg.; meaning disputed: usually ’giving ζειά (a kind of grain)’, an ancient alternative reads ’life-giving’ (from ζάω)
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle
θεοί: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’as a god’ · also plain nom. sg. subject, an unspecified deity left unnamed: ’a god’ (θεὸς δ’ ἐκέδασσεν Ἀχαιούς ’a god scattered the Achaeans’) · also of a goddess (θεός is common gender) · also nom. sg. subject, of a god already introduced by epithets but not yet named: ’the god’
θνητοῖσι: θνητός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
θοὴν: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θύελλα: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall, whirlwind; fem. nom. sg.
θῆκε: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθηκε)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
καθύπερθε: καθύπερθε(ν) — above, from above; adv., + gen.: ’above’ (καθύπερθε Χίοιο ’above Chios’) · also plain adv., no case: ’overhead, above’
καλυψοῦς: Καλυψώ — Calypso, a nymph; fem. gen. sg.
καλυψὼ: Καλυψώ — Calypso, the nymph who keeps Odysseus on her island, her name built on καλύπτω ’hide, conceal’; nom. sg.
κατήλυθον: κατέρχομαι — come down, put in (from the sea); aor. 1 sg. · also aor. 3 pl. (identical form): ’they came down’ (of Telemachus and Athena reaching the ship) · also aor. 1 pl.: ’we came down’ (forced by the following verb)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’)
κρέα: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic κρέα contr.)
κρονίων: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, Zeus; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Κρονίδης
κύμασιν: κῦμα — wave, billow; neut. dat. pl.
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’
κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’) · also acc. sg., direct object: μέγα κῦμα ’a great wave’
λαίλαπι: λαῖλαψ — squall, whirlwind; fem. dat. sg.
λαμπετίη: Λαμπετίη — Lampetie (’Shining’), a daughter of the Sun; fem. nom. sg., epic -ίη (= Attic -ία)
λεύκ: λευκός — white; neut. nom. pl., elided (λεύκ’ = λευκά) · also neut. acc. pl., elided (λεύκ’ = λευκά), agreeing with ὀστέα: ’white’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάκαρες: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (esp. of the gods); masc. nom. pl. · also voc. pl. in address: μάκαρες θεοί ’blessed gods!’
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κῆρα · also agreeing with νῆα (θοὴν ἀνὰ νῆα μέλαιναν ’the swift black ship’) · also standing for a noun left out: ’a black (ewe)’ (θῆλύν τε μέλαιναν)
μένοντες: μένω — remain, wait, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’waiting’
μέσσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle; masc. dat. sg., epic doubled-σ (= Attic μέσῳ): ’in the midst of’
μέσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle of; masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ: ’in the middle of the sea’ · also used alone as a noun, ’in the middle’ (ἐν μέσῳ ’in the middle’)
μακρὸν: μακρός — long, far; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’far, loudly’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’tall’ (κίονα μακρὸν ’a tall pillar’)
μεγάλοι: μέγας — great, large; masc. nom. pl.
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’) · also + gen., ’among, in company with’ (μετ’ ἄλλων … ἑταίρων ’among your other companions’)
μετηύδα: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’ · also gen. with ἄγχι: ’near me’ (μευ ἄγχι στᾶσα) · also gen. of possession, ’my’ (οἵ μευ … κῆρ ’my heart’)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νείκεα: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νείκη)
νεκύεσσι: νεκύς — dead man, corpse; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
νηλέι: νηλής — pitiless, ruthless; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νηλεῖ)
νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
νωλεμέως: νωλεμέως — without a break, relentlessly, unyieldingly; adv.
νότος: Νότος — the South Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg.
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’)
οἴνοπι: οἶνοψ — wine-dark, wine-faced (of the sea); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὐρανόθεν: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; adv. οὐρανόθεν, -θεν ’from’: ’from the sky’
οὐρανὸς: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. nom. sg.
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl. (elided πάντ’): ’everything’ · also masc. acc. sg., elided, agreeing with μῆνα: ’the whole (month)’
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’)
πέλασαν: πελάζω — bring near, bring to; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἐπέλασαν)
πέσεν: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεσεν): ’fell’
πέσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεσον): ’I fell’
παννύχιος: παννύχιος — all night long; masc. nom. sg. used adverbially
παρὲξ: παρέξ — beside, past, beyond; adv./prep. + acc., here adverbial with εἴποιμι: ’say otherwise, speak beside the point’ · also adv. with ἐλάσωσιν, ’past, beyond’ (τάς γε παρὲξ ἐλάσωσιν ’drive past them’) · also prep. + acc.: ’past, beyond’ (παρὲξ τὴν νῆσον ἐλαύνετε ’drive past the island’)
περιμήκεα: περιμήκης — very long; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (-εα = Attic -η)
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’)
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’ · also attributive, neut. nom. sg. agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also neut. acc. sg. as substantive object: ’much (wine)’ · also adj.: ’big’
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’ · also + dat. ‘against’ · also + dat., ’on, upon’: ποτὶ χθονί ’on the ground’
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρυμνῇ: πρύμνη — stern (of a ship); dat. sg.
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
πόντος: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. nom. sg.
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πῃ: πῃ — in some way, anywhere; enclitic adv.
σκόπελον: σκόπελος — rock, crag, cliff; masc. acc. sg.
σκύλλην: Σκύλλη — Scylla, the sea monster; fem. acc. sg., Ionic/epic (= Attic Σκύλλαν)
σκύλλης: Σκύλλη — Scylla, the sea-monster of the cliff; fem. gen. sg.
στησάμενοι: ἵστημι — set up, place; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having set up’ (also ’having taken a stand’, drawn up in line)
συνέεργον: συνείργω (συνέργω) — shut together, bind together; impf. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic συνεῖργον): ’I tied together’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’)
τανύπεπλος: τανύπεπλος — long-robed; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Helen (τανύ- ’long’ + πέπλος ’robe’)
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: masc./neut. dat. pl. ’in which, with which’ (τετυγμένα, τοῖς ἐνάμελγεν ’well-made, in which he milked’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. dat. pl.: ’the’ (ἰχθύσι τοῖς ὀλίγοισι ’for the little fishes’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
τρόπιος: τρόπις — keel; fem. gen. sg., governed by περί: ’around, astride the keel’
τυτθὰ: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’in small bits’
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’
τῆμος: τῆμος — then, at that time; correlative temporal adv. answering ἦμος ’when’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
φέρε: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg. (same form): φέρε χηλὸν ’bring the chest’
φέρεσθαι: φέρω — carry; mid. pres. inf.: ’to carry off for oneself’ · also pass. inf., ’to be carried’ (by the wind): Βορέῃ προβάλεσκε φέρεσθαι ’would toss it to the North Wind to be carried’
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φαίνετο: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, seem; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφαίνετο)
φερόμην: φέρω — carry; impf. pass. 1 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐφερόμην): ’I was carried, I drifted’
χάρυβδιν: Χάρυβδις — Charybdis, the whirlpool monster; fem. acc. sg.
χεῖρε: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. dual: ’his two hands’
χθιζὸς: χθιζός — of yesterday, yesterday’s; masc. nom. sg., used adverbially: ’yesterday’
χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration
χωόμενος: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀίδαο: Ἀΐδης (Ἅιδης) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου): ’of/in Hades’ house’
ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ἀμφ’ Ἄρεος φιλότητος ’about the love of Ares’) · also with ὀστεόφιν, ’around’ (ἀμφ’ ὀστεόφιν θὶς ’a heap around the bones’)
ἀνά: ἀνά — up, up along; prep. + acc., or adv. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνά … ἔβαινον = ἀνέβαινον ’mounted’); acute kept before an enclitic
ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνέμοισιν: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀνέστη: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood up’
ἀναβάντες: ἀναβαίνω — go up, go aboard, embark; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having embarked’
ἀνερροίβδησε: ἀναρροιβδέω — gulp down, suck down; aor. 3 sg. (ῥ doubled after the augment): ’it sucked down’
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen.
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρίστας: ἄριστος — best; fem. acc. pl.: ’the best (cattle)’
ἀργῆτι: ἀργής — bright, vivid white, gleaming; masc. dat. sg., of the lightning-flash (distinct root from ἀργός)
ἀστερόεντα: ἀστερόεις — starry; masc. acc. sg., with οὐρανόν
ἁλμυρὸν: ἁλμυρός — briny, salty; adj., neut. acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ)
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλη: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. sg., adverbial in the idiom ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’one this way, another that’ · also plain adj., fem. nom. sg.: ’other’ (οὔ τις ... ἄλλη ’no other woman’)
ἄλλοθεν: ἄλλοθεν — from elsewhere, from another place; adv. (ἄλλος + -θεν ’from’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄμυδις: ἄμυδις — together, at once, in a body; adv.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual pron./adj., used with a dual verb · also with a plural noun: ἄμφω χεῖρας ’both hands’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄρουραν: ἄρουρα — tilled land, plowland, earth; acc. sg.
ἄτην: ἄτη — ruinous blindness, delusion (sent by a god), ruin; fem. acc. sg.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows) · also accented ἐγώ before the enclitic μιν that follows
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλάσαντες: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive off; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having driven off’
ἐλείπομεν: λείπω — leave, quit; impf. 1 pl.: ’we were leaving’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμυθεόμην: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak; impf. 1 sg. mid., iterative sense: ’I used to tell’
ἐμῇσι: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic ἐμαῖς)
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐννῆμαρ: ἐννῆμαρ — for nine days; adv. (ἐννέα + ἦμαρ)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’)
ἐπαύσατο: παύω (mid.) — cease, stop; aor. mid. 3 sg., intransitive
ἐπιβῆναι: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot on, step on (+ gen.); aor. inf.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’
ἐρίηρες: ἐρίηρος — trusty, dear (of companions; exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. pl.
ἐρύσαντες: ἐρύω — draw, haul; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having hauled up’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐυπλόκαμος: ἐϋπλόκαμος — fair-tressed, with fine hair; fem. nom. sg. (Calypso’s standing epithet) · also used of Demeter (5.125), so not unique to Calypso despite the parenthetical above · also of Dawn (ἐυπλόκαμος Ἠώς ’fine-plaited Dawn’) · also of Circe (Κίρκη ἐυπλόκαμος ’fine-plaited Circe’)
ἐφίλει: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was fond of, cherished’
ἐφοίτων: φοιτάω — roam, go to and fro, come repeatedly; impf. 3 pl.: ’came thronging’
ἐχόμην: ἔχω — mid. hold on, cling to; impf. 1 sg. + gen.: ’I clung to’
ἐόντες: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντες): ’being’
ἑζόμενος: ἕζομαι — sit down, sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting up’
ἑξῆμαρ: ἑξῆμαρ — for six days (ἕξ ’six’ + ἦμαρ ’day’); adv.
ἑτάρους: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); acc. pl.
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form), address: ’companions!’
ἔασε: ἐάω — allow, let; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic εἴασε): ’allowed’
ἔκταμεν: ἐκτέμνω — cut out, cut down; aor. 3 sg. (ν-movable), unaugmented (= ἐξέταμε)
ἔμβαλε: ἐμβάλλω — throw into, cast into; aor. 3 sg.
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily, without a break’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, with suffix -θεν · also ’on the one side’ (ἔνθεν μὲν γὰρ πέτραι ’on one side are rocks’)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (κακὸν … ἔργον τε ἔπος τε μελέτω ’let no evil deed or word be a care’) · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition/predicative, naming a maker: ἔργον Ἡφαίστοιο ’the work of Hephaestus’
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔστησε: ἵστημι — set, set up, station; aor. 3 sg. transitive: ’set (it) up’
ἕταροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl., epic by-form ἕταροι (= ἑταῖροι)
ἠελίοιο: Ἠέλιος — the Sun (god); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic Ἡλίου)
ἠελίῳ: ἥλιος — sun; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέλιος (= Attic ἥλιος)
ἠυκόμοιο: ἠΰκομος — fine-haired, with beautiful hair; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), epithet of goddesses
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’)
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl. ’we’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I have come’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj.
ἰκριόφιν: ἴκρια — half-decks, deck-planks (at bow and stern of a ship); neut. pl. in -φι(ν), serving as gen. or dat.
ἰφθίμῃ: Ἰφθίμη — Iphthime, Penelope’s sister, wife of Eumelus; fem. dat. sg. · also ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout; adj., fem. dat. sg. form, qualifying θυγατέρ’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱστόν: ἱστός — loom; masc. acc. sg. · also ’mast’ (of a ship), a distinct sense required by nautical context (ἐν δ’ ἱστόν τ’ ἐτίθεντο ’they set the mast in it’)
ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀλοοῖς: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; masc. dat. pl.
ὀλοὴν: ὀλοός — deadly, destructive; fem. acc. sg.
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind; in Homer also ’hereafter, in time to come’; adv. · also ’back, home again’, of return (οἴκαδ’ ὀπίσσω ’back home’)
ὀστέ: ὀστέον (pl. ὀστέα) — bone; neut. nom. pl., elided (ὀστέ’ = ὀστέα)
ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’)
ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
ὁπότ: ὁπότε (elided ὁπότ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj., here introducing a vivid simile · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὁπότ’ ἰθύσει’ … ’whenever he made a dash’)
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅπλα: ὅπλον — tool, gear; pl. ship’s tackle and rigging (not weapons here); neut. acc. pl.
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὑπέκφυγον: ὑπεκφεύγω — escape from under, slip away; aor. 1 sg. or 3 pl.: ’escaped’
ὑπέρβιον: ὑπέρβιος — overweening, excessive; fem./neut. acc. sg.
ὑπερίονι: Ὑπερίων — Hyperion, a name of the Sun; masc. dat. sg., in apposition with Ἠελίῳ
ὑψόσ: ὑψόσε — up on high, aloft; adv., elided ὑψόσ’
ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
ὕπνῳ: ὕπνος — sleep; masc. dat. sg. (ὕπνῳ γλυκερῷ ’sweet sleep’)
ὠγυγίην: Ὠγυγίη — Ogygia, the island of Calypso; acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν: ’in his own (mind)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: which; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν: ’in which’ (ᾗσιν ἀγαλλόμενοι ’taking pride in which’)
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
